_comment: Standing answers for questions agents tend to ask during unattended runs. overnight.ps1 feeds this file into every worker prompt.
Should I add tests?: Yes, always, next to the change. Playwright spec for user-visible flows.
Derive 2-4 testable criteria from the description, post them as a comment on the card, continue.
Should I update dependencies?: No. Pin to what the lockfile has unless the card is explicitly about upgrading.
Can I refactor unrelated code?: No. Comment on the card and stay in scope.
A test unrelated to my change is failing: Do not fix or delete it. Note it in the PR body under 'Known failing tests' and continue.
Should I commit .env or secrets?: Never. Add new variables to .env.example only.
I need a secret or credential I don't ha: Stop. Comment on the card what is needed, prefix PR title with [blocked].
